why: State cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/state-1.md, P1 state-1.4): an edit form in a `Sheet` (`FormField`s, one `FormRow` with a `Select` and a `NumberField`, `useFormDraft`). The user changes the amount, waits for the autosave and reloads. The sheet reopens from the URL with 'Draft restored from this device.', but `[data-slot="form-row"]` and every descendant measure 0 px tall, with normal computed `display` and `visibility`. The restored amount is invisible and Save submits it. A draft that changed only the note draws the row, and so does reopening the record by click. Repro: `apps/playground/src/cycle/state-1/OrdersPage.tsx`, route `/cycle-state`; the probe is described in the findings file.
what: A restored draft never hides a field.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/ui/sheet.tsx and packages/basalt-ui/src/ui/number-field.tsx, only for this defect
a new layout test and fixture under packages/basalt-ui/tests/layout/
change: Reproduce in a layout fixture: a `Sheet` open on first mount, a form with a `FormRow` holding a `NumberField`, and `useFormDraft` restoring a stored draft whose number differs from the default. Find why the `FormRow` subtree (an `@container`) gets no layout after the restore, and fix the cause in the component that owns it. The fixture then asserts every field of the row has a non-zero height after the restore, at 1800 and 390 px.
commits: fix: one commit in packages/basalt-ui per component touched.
proof: make check; the layout test; the cause named in the PR.
acceptance: A restored number draft in a Sheet leaves every FormRow field visible with a non-zero height at 1800 and 390 px (layout test)
The PR names the cause it fixed
out_of_scope: Clearing the draft on submit (v3-state-1-state); any new export.
